correctness.rationale: The exact homogeneous 3×3 companion matrix C(w,v) has unit constant vector. For alternating reciprocal ratios t,1/t, direct symbolic multiplication produces characteristic polynomial (λ−1)(λ²−S(t)λ+P(t)), with S,P rational as stated. For t>0, the Jury expressions 1−P and 1−S+P are everywhere strictly positive; the third 1+S+P is positive precisely for 4(t+t^(−1))²−10(t+t^(−1))−49<0. This yields closed zero-stable [t*,t*^(−1)], strict interior parasitic stability, and simple −1 root on the boundaries; outside one parasitic modulus exceeds 1. The explicit determinant of the frozen C(t,1/t) exceeds 1 in modulus for 0<t<1/4, providing a strict stable-product/unstable-factor interval, reciprocal counterpart by phase reversal. Independently recomputed symbolic trace, determinant and critical Jury factor with exact SymPy algebra. No claim about arbitrary variable-step schedules.
